WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, cp.brand,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin, count(*) n_lines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT 'sales' src, count(*) n_rows, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) n_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) n_rl, sum(CASE WHEN standard_cost IS NULL OR standard_cost=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zero_cost, sum(CASE WHEN net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) null_net, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), sum(CASE WHEN standard_cost_returned IS NULL OR standard_cost_returned=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), sum(CASE WHEN refund_net IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), min(return_date), max(return_date)
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

SELECT count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.standard_cost - f.quantity*p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cost_mismatch,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_qty,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_net,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.net_amount < f.standard_cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) below_cost,
       sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pk_out_of_validity
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND cs.region='South'

SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost),2) AS gross_margin_asis,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN n.region_then='South' THEN n.net_sales - n.cost ELSE 0 END),2) AS gross_margin_aswas
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4
  AND (cs.region = 'South' OR n.region_then = 'South')
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY (SUM(CASE WHEN cs.region='South' THEN n.net_sales - n.cost ELSE 0 END)) DESC
LIMIT 10
